Four important instructions to follow:: (1) Always verify the voltage and polarity of each individual string before making a
parallel connection. Electrical and electronic components can be irreparably damaged
if an array string is connected in reverse polarity to another.
(2) If you measure a reversed polarity or a difference of more than 10V between strings
then check the string configuration before making the connection.
